title: Sponges dry above campfires
description: Finally dry your sponges above campfires
body:
Mod pretty much does what the name implies. 

**Place** a **sponge** above an active **campfire** and it will **dry** in 10 seconds, 5 seconds if placed above a **soul campfire**. 

Entirely vibecoded with Claude at 4am 

Enjoy your **dry** sponges!


Regarding feature requests/questions, feel free to write @thepolishguy69 on Discord.
